audio_deleted: Original audio was deleted after the retention period (measurements are kept)
integrity_error: Integrity error: the checksum of recording #{id} has changed since it was recorded. The file is damaged, do not use it any further.
calibration_too_loud: Chain noise of {db:.1f} dBFS is too loud (expected < {max:.0f} dBFS). The stylus was probably down; please repeat with the stylus UP.
analyze_first: The recording must be analyzed first
both_analyze_first: Both recordings must be analyzed first
copy_note: Two copies of the same record ({a} / {b}): the differences are differences between the copies, not the effect of cleaning.
profile_note: The recordings come from different turntables ({a} / {b}): differences may come from the turntable, not only from the record.
